title: Speaking — Borrowing things
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on borrowing things.

questions: What do you like about the room you use most?
Is there a part of your home you rarely use?
How long have you lived in your current home?
What would you put in a room of your own?
What sort of things do you borrow most often?
Do you usually lend things to people you know?

part2.topic: Describe something useful you borrowed instead of buying.
part2.closing: and explain why borrowing was a good choice in that situation.

questions: Which objects are best suited to neighbourhood lending schemes?
How could a borrowing service encourage users to return things on time?
How has everyday life connected with borrowing things changed for people of different ages?
